title: Ordinary tensor comparison in explicit site coordinates
statement: On any essentially small site, let siteTensorIso be an abbreviation of the existing siteSheafTensorRightIso from the explicit siteSheafTensorRight functor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] to the existing monoidal tensor by sheafifying siteTensorRightIso and composing with tensorObjIsoSheafification inverse. It is natural in the first variable and sends siteSheafTensorTmul to tensorSection. Given a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l, schemes X,Y, a morphism f:X→Y, Base b and a normalized Geometry g for f [def-sp-tower-shriek-data] and GeometryOrdinaryTensor T [lem-coef-semilinear-geometric-ordinary-tensor] on its ordinary fields, define comparison(g,T) by conjugating T.system with these source and target isomorphisms and transporting along g.coefficients, g.transitions and g.pull_eq. It is a natural isomorphism tensorRight(N) followed by g.pull to g.pull followed by tensorRight(g.pull N), on actual systems [def-sfb-tower-class-tensor-pullback].

source.place: clause (2), finite unit and tensor maps and their transposes

proof.text: Use siteSheafTensorRightIso, siteTensorRightIso and tensorRightPresentation, the proved shared comparisons of [lem-weil-pbc-independent-sheaf-tensor-colimits]. The existing siteSheafTensorRightIso identifies the explicit sheafified site tensor with the monoidal tensor. Expand its presentation at a component and combine the two counit tensor factors to identify it with sheafification of siteTensorRightIso followed by tensorObjIsoSheafification inverse. Naturality of the module sheafification unit then proves its pure-section formula. Forget only the derived fields of the normalized generic geometry. T.system_natural yields the natural monoidal comparison with fixed second variable. Conjugate by the two existing bridges and eliminate the specified coefficient, transition and functor equalities.

def comparison {b : SpTowerShriek.Base l E}
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} (g : SpTowerShriek.Geometry l E b f)
    (T : SemilinearSections.GeometryOrdinaryTensor.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
      (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) (SpTowerShriek.B l E Y) (SpTowerShriek.tau l E Y)
      (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
      (Scheme.proEtaleSheafInverseImage f (Type (u + 1)))
      (Scheme.proEtaleSheafDirectImage f (Type (u + 1)))
      (Scheme.proEtaleSheafAdjunction f (Type (u + 1))) (ordinaryGeometry l E g)) :
    ∀ N : Systems Y (Arings l E Y),
      SpTowerClasses.tensorRight l E Y N ⋙ g.pull ≅
        g.pull ⋙ SpTowerClasses.tensorRight l E X (g.pull.obj N)
